confirmation.rule: Each independent new library must receive 20 valid genuine selections, beat historical 3/20 and the current constrained original library, and match or exceed its free strict result. One or both must strictly improve over their own free strict result.

limitations: Preregistered after observing failures of unconstrained parsing on this same benchmark. Model selects each boolean or enum value while the decoder fixes the JSON structure and field order. The two independent libraries share the same 20 target IDs. Other field types and project-specific transfer are untested.

inference_interruption.interruption: Released CUDA allocations after two simultaneous studies caused GPU memory thrashing. Restart the same weight/model on the same registered inputs. A not-yet-recorded forward pass may be repeated. Keep every completed response. No official scores available.
